The first AI debate tournament. You get one Saturday to build a voice agent that argues AI ethics and risk: it hears the opposing case live, forms a rebuttal in seconds, and answers out loud. events.title: Energy Optimization of GPUs through Self-Improving Agents
events.venue: AGI House SF: 170 St. Germain Ave. San Francisco CA 94114
events.description:
Most inference clusters burn far more energy than the work requires. This evening covers the architecture behind a different approach: self-improving agents that keep tuning the serving stack, batching, tensor parallelism, prefix caching, expert routing, until 8 GPUs deliver the throughput you would normally provision 16 for, at roughly half the energy.
Hamza Farooq and the Traversaal team have been building this in the open at energy.traversaal.ai, an inference API priced at a flat $10 per kilowatt-hour instead of per token. Billing on energy changes the incentives: every watt the system saves makes the model genuinely cheaper to call, not just cheaper on the rate card. Their current numbers: 88% under token rates, 0.22s median time to first token.

events.title: Cash Pay to Covered: Agentic Insurance Ops for GLP-1s w/ Neon, Mochi & Elion
events.description:
Cash pay got a generation of digital health companies to scale, including GLP-1s, birth control, hair medications, and sexual health drugs. Insurance is where the next order of magnitude sits, and it is a different operational problem entirely: benefit verification against several hundred payers, prior authorization portal chaos, and endless waiting on hold. Most teams model the revenue upside long before they model the operations.
We are putting both sides of that problem on stage: the team building the agents, and the team running a D2C healthcare organization at national scale. Expect specifics on where agents unlock new revenue opportunities, and where they do not.
